diagnosis: The issue lies in the DFA state transitions, particularly at line 463. The current implementation does not correctly handle the transition when encountering a semicolon ';' which should trigger comment processing but instead leads to incorrect tokenization.

causal_chain: Line 463 computes next_state based on base[state] - ch >=0, which may fail for certain characters like ';'
This failure causes the DFA to not transition into a comment-skipping state
As a result, subsequent characters are treated as separate tokens instead of being ignored as part of a comment

assumption: Add a new state for comment processing and adjust transitions accordingly

edits.rationale: Introduce a dedicated comment state to handle ';' correctly
edits.replacement: if (state == INITIAL && ch == ';') { return(COMMENT_STATE); } else if(base[state]-ch >=0)

edits.rationale: Define behavior for COMMENT_STATE to skip until newline or EOF
